title: The 4 Best Leaf Blowers Under $200
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for leaf blowers under $200, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at leaf blowers under $200 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: EGO Power+ LB6504 650 CFM Cordless Leaf Blower
products.blurb: Key specs: 56V ARC Lithium battery, 5.0Ah included, Up to 650 CFM turbo airflow, Up to 75 minutes runtime per charge.
strengths: Longest warranty of any blower in this category
650 CFM and 75-minute runtime handle most yards without a second battery
limitations: Sits near the top of this budget range rather than the bottom
Heaviest handheld model in this category
Turbo mode still drains the battery faster than moderate speed
features: Up to 75 minutes runtime per charge

products.name: Ryobi 40V HP Brushless Whisper Series 650 CFM Leaf Blower
products.blurb: Key specs: 40V HP Brushless motor, 650 CFM / 160 MPH, Whisper Series low-noise housing, Cruise control trigger lock.
strengths: Matches the EGO's 650 CFM at a typically lower bundled price
Quieter operation, a genuine advantage over the EGO in tight neighborhoods
Battery shared with the broader Ryobi 40V outdoor tool lineup
limitations: 1-year tool warranty versus the EGO's 5 years
Battery-included kits vary more in price and availability than the EGO's
Fewer accessory options than the EGO ecosystem

products.name: Greenworks 40V 185 MPH 340 CFM Cordless Blower/Vacuum
products.blurb: Key specs: 185 MPH / 340 CFM brushless motor, 2-in-1 blower and vacuum with bag, Includes 4.0Ah battery and charger.
strengths: Vacuum mode adds function the EGO and Ryobi don't include
Lightest full kit in this category
limitations: 340 CFM is meaningfully lower than the EGO or Ryobi's 650 CFM
Best suited to smaller yards rather than large or wet-leaf jobs
Not the pick if raw airflow is the priority

products.name: Toro PowerJet F700 Corded Electric Leaf Blower
products.blurb: Key specs: 725 CFM airflow, 140 MPH air speed, 12-amp motor, No battery required.
strengths: Leaves plenty of budget room, typically the least expensive pick outright
No battery to degrade or replace over time
limitations: Corded design is the real limiting factor, not price
No runtime concerns, but no cordless freedom either
Doesn't use the extra budget headroom for anything beyond the base tool

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
